stem: Which statement explains the difference between the apples in “American Apple” and the grandfather’s collection in the excerpt from Bend, Not Break: A Life in Two Worlds?

options.label: F
options.text: The apples represent unreachable goals, while the grandfather’s collection represents true beauty.

options.label: G
options.text: The apples represent the power of determination, while the grandfather’s collection represents the wisdom of experience.

options.label: H
options.text: The apples represent temptations in life, while the grandfather’s collection represents the difficult choices people must make in life.

options.label: J
options.text: The apples represent the danger of materialism, while the grandfather’s collection represents the will to overcome temptation.
